user_statement: available_at 的含义是作为历史数据可以被获取的时间，盘中作为实时数据的获取是实时的。
supersedes_interpretations: 15:30 available_at means the intraday bar was unavailable in realtime
historical available_at alone establishes source_availability_gap for intraday research
K-line root-cause attribution must wait for realtime reception logs because of this field
historical_artifact_policy: Preserve sealed bytes, calculations and audit chronology. Read old availability-gap labels and literal-15:30 scenarios as superseded field interpretations, not the current data contract or proof of actual live delay.
runtime_timing_contract: Realtime analysis uses completed bars and information known by the decision time. Historical retrieval availability must not be substituted for realtime decision-time availability.
scope_limit: This clarifies field meaning. It does not invent measured feed latency, revision histories, fills or an ETF execution account. Those are separate questions and not prerequisites for the next descriptive K-line attribution task.
